name: The drive aids config codec matches the firmware's ABS and traction control layout
step: Check the drive aids config codec and Drive Aids page
rationale:
The Drive Aids page (Tuning -> Drive Aids) saves by writing back what it
read. The command ids, the order of the nine ABS U8 fields and the traction control
fields after them (U8 tc_mode, U16 tc_ramp_time; 12 bytes), and their ranges and
defaults are pinned here against the firmware handler (gripora-firmware msp.c,
MSP2_GRIPORA_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F3F / MSP2_GRIPORA_SET_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F40,
pg/drive_aids.h): the firmware refuses the whole write if any value is out of
range. A nine-byte reply is older firmware without traction control and is written
back as nine bytes; a longer reply must still decode the known twelve and the write
must stay twelve; a reply shorter than nine is refused. The harness also checks that
the page builds every field, refuses saves while armed, does not reboot, follows the
current PID profile (the settings are stored per profile), and that its menu row
and icon exist.
